description: Dear Candidate, Greetings from Sahasya Global Solutions! We are excited to share an upcoming career opportunity with Copart India for the position of: Customer Support Associate – International Voice Process Interview Drive: 27th August 2026 If you are looking for an opportunity to build your career in an International Voice Process and are interested in exploring this opportunity, we would be happy to consider your profile. Interested? Here’s what you need to do: 1. Share your updated resume with us Please reply to this email with your latest resume . Your profile will first be reviewed and shortlisted by our recruitment team. Only shortlisted candidates will be eligible to proceed for the further interview rounds. 2. Know someone who may be interested? If you have a friend, colleague, ex-colleague, or family member who is actively looking for a similar opportunity, feel free to share this opportunity with them . You can also share their contact number or resume with our recruitment team, and we will reach out to them. 3. Wait for confirmation Once your profile is shortlisted, our team will contact you and share the complete interview details, reporting time, venue, and further instructions . Please note: Do not visit the interview venue without receiving confirmation from our recruitment team, as only shortlisted and confirmed candidates will be eligible for the interview process. We look forward to hearing from you. If you are interested, simply reply to this email with your updated resume and mention “INTERESTED” in the subject/body. You can also help someone in your network discover this opportunity by sharing it with them. Regards, Sahasya Global Solutions Hiring Partner – Copart India
